endpoint_eligibility.held_source_auprc: eligible as retrospective development-only source recovery after leakage-safe construction
endpoint_eligibility.open_champion: ineligible because no wholly sealed graph source exists

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Count only after the corrected 50-study release is promoted and canonical evidence units, cohort families, LD blocks, loci, and deterministic derivatives are frozen.
current_coloc_gwas.warning: Current memberships are provisional and already project-exposed.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only removed-source recovery. Count a qualifying aggregate at most once per experimental replicate, target locus, guide family, gene, and evidence type after aliases and technical lanes are collapsed.
gse281160.topology: same_cell guide and RNA; experimental replicate is the biological unit
gse281160.warning: The 20 targets were selected from MPRA and do not form an unbiased source seal.

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only removed-source recovery. Reporter replicates are evidence units only after assay-native aggregation; MPRA activity alone is not an enhancer-gene link.
gse281364.topology: same_sample_different_aliquot DNA and RNA counts; 16 experimental replicates

gse289173.allowed_use: none for the typed-evidence graph task
gse289173.reason: It is not a registered graph hold-back and its QTL outcomes cannot define graph edges, counts, thresholds, or calibration.

resource_gene_catalog_current.allowed_use: Exposed development content only after an immutable graph promotion. Existing evidence classes and the frozen 117 programs remain read-only authorities, not count thresholds or model-selection targets.

confounding_audit.degree: The count is expected to correlate with graph degree. Report that correlation and performance within degree-matched strata; do not present the baseline as evidence beyond study density.
confounding_audit.duplication: Multiple accessions, rows, technical replicates, derivative edges, or publications from one underlying experiment do not become independent support units.
confounding_audit.observability: Well-studied genes and assays can accumulate more support. Report performance across remaining-source observability strata, but keep held-source observability evaluator-only.
confounding_audit.source_size: Large studies can dominate evidence count. Compare against graph_source_count and report per-source contributions without learning outcome-based weights.
confounding_audit.zero: A numeric zero is emitted only when at least one remaining source is applicable or observable; otherwise the score is structurally_missing.

held_source_protocol.calibration: A future count-to-probability calibrator uses only out-of-fold predictions and labels from remaining development sources. No evaluated-source prevalence, eligibility, threshold, or count distribution enters fitting.
held_source_protocol.candidate_universe: Freeze source-independent variants, loci, and genes before source removal. Held-source-only candidates remain evaluator-only.
held_source_protocol.removal: Delete held-source nodes, edges, inverse edges, provenance, observability, tested status, missingness, aliases, aggregates, degrees, source counts, and deterministic derivatives before evidence-unit deduplication.
held_source_protocol.split: Group ancestry-aware native-build LD blocks, loci, genes, source aliases, and all derivative edges before counting. One locus is the inferential unit.
held_source_protocol.success_interpretation: Remaining evidence density recovers support in an exposed removed source; this is prioritization, not causality.

missingness_and_negative_contract.negative_rule: Only evaluator-designated tested negatives inside the removed source's eligible denominator are negative outcomes. Absence, untestability, and non-applicability are not negatives.
missingness_and_negative_contract.score_rule: Only supported remaining-source evidence increments the native score; every other state remains explicit.

reproducibility_contract.graph_receipt: Hash source rows, canonical IDs, evidence-unit deduplication keys, status masks, held-source removal, and count outputs.
reproducibility_contract.implementation_receipt: Freeze repo revision, algorithm ID, schema, deterministic sort, tie policy, optional calibrator, environment, and output hashes before any score is reported.
reproducibility_contract.unit_of_inference: independent locus; evidence units, source rows, genes, variants, cells, guides, and replicates are not automatically inferential replicates
